decision: Two fresh occupied distinctions written together at a hot unary birth can carry a ring's state into the next growth layer. The one-spare attachment has a deterministic four-write minimum and 57 versus 56 births at fixed first incidence. The bare ring needs twenty writes and gives 20 versus 15. Independent delayed writes can lose the destination.
evidence: Exact computation and proofs within the documented law, preparations, and event conventions
sample: One per named source, allowed physical fresh choice or explicitly enumerated schedule subset in its stated control. The 60 recodings are a deterministic seeded checking sample.
